The high selection pressure of traditional genetic programming causes the population to converge quickly; once diversity collapses, evolution falls into local optima. The diversified prompting strategy (mild/moderate/creative rewriting) further strengthens this tension management—stable rewriting prevents excellent genes from being destroyed, while creative rewriting continuously introduces new research perspectives. This combination allows the system to focus on effective directions while maintaining exploration breadth during evolution.

s56lt:209: Upgrading Alpha representation from mathematical formulas to executable Python code is a paradigm shift whose significance goes far beyond expressiveness. Formula-based factors are constrained by predefined mathematical structures, resulting in a closed search space; code-based factors, by contrast, can contain conditional branches, loop logic, state checks, and even explanatory comments—meaning a factor is no longer just "computing a number" but "describing a verifiable investment logic." When a factor exists as code, its economic semantics can be explicitly expressed through comments and logical structure, providing a structural basis for interpretability and verifiability rather than relying solely on ex post attribution analysis.
